word-residence-permit.note: document allowing a foreigner to live in a country (generic)

word-permanent-residence.note: right to live in a country indefinitely

word-temporary-residence.note: permission to live in a country for a limited time

word-work-permit.note: permission to work in a country

word-citizenship.note: being a legal citizen of a country

word-naturalization.note: becoming a citizen of a new country

word-immigration.note: moving to live in another country

word-immigration-office.note: government office for foreigners' residence matters

word-consulate.note: office of a foreign government in a city

word-fingerprints.note: prints of the fingers taken by authorities

word-fee.note: official charge, payment for a service

word-extension.note: making a permit or visa last longer

word-renew.note: extend the validity of a document

word-appeal.note: ask a higher authority to change a decision

word-address-registration.note: official registration of where you live

word-register-address.note: register your address with the authorities

word-migration-card-ru.note: Russia: migration card filled in on entry (миграционная карта)

word-work-patent-ru.note: Russia: work patent for foreign workers (патент)

word-white-card-rs.note: Serbia: registration of a foreigner's stay (бели картон)

word-residence-record-jp.note: Japan: certificate of residence from the municipality (住民票)

word-residence-card-jp.note: Japan: residence card for foreign residents (在留カード)

word-my-number-jp.note: Japan: individual number for tax and social security (マイナンバー)

word-personal-seal-jp.note: Japan: personal name stamp used instead of a signature (印鑑・はんこ)

word-move-in-notification-jp.note: Japan: notification of moving into a municipality (転入届)

word-accommodation-registration-cn.note: China: police registration of a foreigner's place of stay (住宿登记)

word-empadronamiento-es.note: Spain: registration in the municipal register (empadronamiento)

word-sns-number-pt.note: Portugal: national health service user number (número de utente)

word-aima-pt.note: Portugal: agency for integration, migration and asylum (AIMA)

word-residence-certificate-pt.note: Portugal: certificate of residence from the parish council (atestado de residência)

word-voivodeship-office-pl.note: Poland: regional government office handling residence (urząd wojewódzki)

word-municipal-registration-nl.note: Netherlands: registration with the municipality (inschrijving BRP)

word-digid-nl.note: Netherlands: digital identity login for government services (DigiD)

word-prefecture-fr.note: France: prefecture, office handling residence permits (préfecture)

word-ofii-fr.note: France: French Office for Immigration and Integration (OFII)

word-justificatif-domicile-fr.note: France: proof of address document (justificatif de domicile)

word-social-card-am.note: Armenia: social card with public service number (սոցիալական քարտ)

word-migration-service-am.note: Armenia: migration and citizenship service (Միգրացիոն ծառայություն)

word-foreigner-id-number-tr.note: Turkey: foreign national identification number (yabancı kimlik numarası)

word-migration-administration-tr.note: Turkey: Presidency of Migration Management (Göç İdaresi)

word-codice-fiscale-it.note: Italy: codice fiscale, the personal tax code needed for contracts, work, bank accounts and health care

word-questura-it.note: Italy: questura, the provincial police headquarters where foreigners apply for the permesso di soggiorno

word-tessera-sanitaria-it.note: Italy: tessera sanitaria, the national health insurance card that also carries the codice fiscale

word-residenza-anagrafica-it.note: Italy: residenza anagrafica, official registration of one's address at the comune's registry office

word-spid-it.note: Italy: SPID, the public digital identity login for government and public services

word-personnummer-se.note: Sweden: personnummer, the personal identity number used for taxes, health care, banking, contracts and nearly all services

word-folkbokforing-se.note: Sweden: folkbokföring, the population register; registering one's address there, via Skatteverket, gives a personnummer and access to society

word-skatteverket-se.note: Sweden: Skatteverket, the Swedish Tax Agency, which also handles population registration, personnummer and ID cards

word-bankid-se.note: Sweden: BankID, the electronic ID on phone or computer used to log in to banks, authorities and for signing

word-migrationsverket-se.note: Sweden: Migrationsverket, the Swedish Migration Agency, which handles residence permits, work permits, asylum and citizenship

word-rnokpp-ua.note: Ukraine: РНОКПП (ідентифікаційний код), the taxpayer registration number used for taxes, work, banking and contracts

word-diia-ua.note: Ukraine: Дія, the state app and portal with digital documents (ID, driving licence) and online public services

word-idp-certificate-ua.note: Ukraine: довідка внутрішньо переміщеної особи, the certificate of an internally displaced person, needed for benefits and aid

word-state-migration-service-ua.note: Ukraine: Державна міграційна служба (ДМС), the agency issuing ID cards, passports and residence permits

word-ppsn-ie.note: Ireland: PPSN, Personal Public Service Number, the personal ID number for tax, social welfare, health services and employment

word-irish-residence-permit-ie.note: Ireland: IRP, Irish Residence Permit, the registration card issued to non-EEA residents by Immigration Service Delivery (formerly GNIB card)

word-public-services-card-ie.note: Ireland: Public Services Card (PSC), the photo ID card linked to the PPSN, used for social welfare and other state services

word-national-insurance-number-uk.note: UK: National Insurance number, the personal number for tax, work and state benefits

word-evisa-uk.note: UK: eVisa, the online record of immigration status that replaced the biometric residence permit card

word-taj-number-hu.note: Hungary: TAJ-szám, the social security number on the TAJ card, needed for health care and employment

word-address-card-hu.note: Hungary: lakcímkártya, the address card proving one's registered residence address, needed for contracts and services

word-tax-id-card-hu.note: Hungary: adóazonosító jel, the personal tax identification number, shown on the adókártya (tax card), needed for work and taxes

word-kormanyablak-hu.note: Hungary: kormányablak, the government window, a one-stop district office for ID cards, address registration and many official matters

word-ugyfelkapu-hu.note: Hungary: Ügyfélkapu, the secure online client gateway for e-government services such as taxes, health records and official letters

word-temporary-residence-registration-vn.note: Vietnam: đăng ký tạm trú, registering a temporary stay with the local ward police or commune; required for foreigners and for non-local Vietnamese

word-temporary-residence-card-vn.note: Vietnam: thẻ tạm trú, the temporary residence card issued to foreigners with a long-term visa, e.g. for work or family

word-citizen-id-card-vn.note: Vietnam: căn cước công dân (CCCD), the chip-based citizen ID card with the 12-digit personal identification number

word-tax-code-vn.note: Vietnam: mã số thuế, the personal tax code needed for employment, income tax and business; for citizens it equals the personal ID number
